title: Red Hat Security Advisory: ruby:3.3 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in Ruby 3.3, including a double free issue in the regular expression parser and several integer overflow issues in the regular expression compiler. These vulnerabilities have been addressed in a security update released by Red Hat for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. The update rebases Ruby 3.3 to the latest upstream release, incorporating these security fixes along with bug fixes and enhancements.
